title: Being woken up in the real world randomly and constantly once you become lucid .
content: I’ve noticed for about the past week and a half now that anytime I became lucid in my dreams or feel like I was dreaming about something important /figuring things out I am always randomly woken up by something in the real world . No matter what day after day whenever I am in a dream I will get some random phone that wakes me up even though my phone will be on do not disturb , (and the phone calls are not just random telemarketing) The fire alarm going off in my house randomly (there is no fire and I’ve changed batteries many times, it doesn’t beep when I’m awake only starts being when I am deep in sleep ) weird loud noises that will just randomly happen around my house (sounds like something slammed a door or punched a wall) but no one else is here . I mean heck even the other day I was in a deep dream , I randomly get awoken by someone I have not even talked to in months and they called me , I answered and they were freaking out saying “I just had to call you I am so worried about you are you okay “ like freaking out , I say “ya I’m fine what’s going on “ , they just keep going on about how worried they are for me out of nowhere randomly then they hang up and I have not heard from them at all since then . Like it’s just to many things to be a coincidence. I’m a very very heavy sleeper as well and for all these things to happen plus more when I am in a deep dream , then awoken constantly by weird random things or situations. It feels like whatever is in the dream world trying to keep us from seeing what’s happening or remembering/ trying to figure out what the hell is going on is in the real world as well and is working both sides .
